name: filter-wc-orders
description: Sniffer, Linter, Pretty Printer for WordPress Projects

scripts.make-pot: php -d xdebug.max_nesting_level=512 $(which wp) i18n make-pot --exclude="node_modules/,languages/,.gitignore,.gitmodules,.gulpfile.js,.git,.webpack.config.js,package,json,package-lock.json,phpcs.xml,phpmd.xml,license.txt,readme.txt,assets/" --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"https://github.com/dineshinau/quick-plugin-switcher/issues/", "language-team":"LANGUAGE <EMAIL@ADDRESS>"}' . languages/filter-wc-orders.pot
scripts.zip: rm -f $npm_package_name.zip && npm run make-pot && mkdir -p $npm_package_name && cp -r admin/ languages/ index.php readme.txt $npm_package_name.php $npm_package_name && zip -r $npm_package_name.zip $npm_package_name && rm -r $npm_package_name

author: Christoph Herr
